description: Wait for the next event in an inbox after a cursor, up to 30s. Auth: Authorization Bearer read token header.

after.description: Only return the first event with an id greater than this cursor (0 for the first event).

body_contains.description: Only return an event whose body contains this text.

inbox_id.description: The inbox id returned when the inbox was created (private; the slug in the ingest URL is the public part).

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait in milliseconds (max 30000).

name: wait_for_event
